scope: Synthetic durable notebook exchanges through InMemorySyncTransport. No CloudKit, network latency, real app data, debounce, background scheduling, or rendering. Markdown publication is separate.
method: Three sequential repetitions per case on macOS 27.0 arm64, Xcode 27.0, Swift 6.4, Release. Fixture generation and copying excluded. Identical fixture within a case; regenerated actors/catalog values across runs. Warm filesystem. p95 is maximum with three samples.
